scope: VOID N1 using the approved v127a visual owners; source checkpoint, not a production or all-platform release.
recovery: Check out this tag in a new DESERT checkout, leaving existing stores and approved previews untouched.
Use the companion VOID n1-stable tag in a sibling checkout; its checkpoint records the exact SDK commit.
Use Node v24.16.0 and install the locked dependencies in both repositories.
From VOID, run node scripts/build-web.ts build/void-n1-restored using a fresh destination.
Start with a new local test store or an explicitly selected compatible existing store; never reset or repin a store to bypass admission.
Frozen generated builds and complete screenshot evidence remain local; this source checkpoint does not publish binaries or Apple sample assets.
qualification: Owner-approved local web baseline. The finite Chromium matrix is not a whole-suite, native-browser or all-platform certification.
